official_specification.acquisition: Official primary specification opened with the web tool; rendered cached page reported a crawl three days earlier.
official_specification.required_work: Use a built-in or library hash table to look up and update counts for all overlapping windows at lengths 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12 and 18; grow the tables and retain the prescribed algorithm, not only its output.

implementation_findings: Width-1/2 histogram code uses indexed dense counter storage, not library hash-table entry updates.
Longer histogram/query proof regions directly count the selected query; the emitted loop has no hash-table call.
The unchanged Mech source expresses histograms, but generated code removes the benchmark-mandated table work. Generic semantic validity does not establish workload conformance.
next_work: Qualify a generic hash-table-preserving native lowering that fuses window production without removing the actual library entry lookup/update for each required window. Preserve the canonical resource lifecycle, errors, ownership and finite accounting. Do not insert a nucleotide-specific host helper or change protected Rust programs.
